python - <<'PY'
from boltons.iterutils import remap, research, split, split_iter
for source in ([1, None, 2], (1, None, 2), iter([1, None, 2]), 'abc', []):
    expected = list(source)
    assert split(iter(expected), maxsplit=0) == [expected]
    assert list(split_iter(iter(expected), maxsplit=0)) == [expected]
cycle = {'value': 1}
cycle['self'] = cycle
for cache in (True, None, {}):
    result = remap(cycle, cache=cache)
    assert result is result['self'] and result is not cycle
    if isinstance(cache, dict):
        assert cache[id(cycle)] is result
        assert remap(cycle, cache=cache) is result
    assert research(cycle, lambda p, k, v: isinstance(v, int), cache=True) == [(('value',), 1)]
shared = [1]
root = [shared, shared]
assert remap(root)[0] is not shared
mapped = remap(root)
assert mapped[0] is mapped[1]
mapped = remap(root, cache=False)
assert mapped[0] is not mapped[1]
assert research(root, lambda p, k, v: isinstance(v, int), cache=False) == [((0, 0), 1), ((1, 0), 1)]
assert research(root, lambda p, k, v: isinstance(v, int)) == [((0, 0), 1)]
cache = {}
research(cycle, cache=cache)
assert id(cycle) in cache
print('Cache, cycle, shared-reference, and zero-split checks passed')
